title: Restricted Evaluation Blocks URI
symptoms: Nix eval fails with 'restricted mode' error

diagnosis_steps.logic: Is URI 'file://' and inside repo/mirrors? Or is it remote (http/https)?

resolution_options.condition: URI is local mirror path (file://) but missing from allowlist
actions: Update tools/env_manager.py to include this path in allowlist
Identified as policy violation: Build step attempting network access
Check flake.nix/lock for unpinned input or non-fixed-output derivation
Convert input to use 'pinned-rocm' or prefetch

prohibited_actions: DO NOT add remote URIs to allowlist
DO NOT disable restrict-eval to bypass
